The seashell does not move. Natural continuous movement, steady camera, sound of wind and surf.

She bends down and picks up the small seashell, which lies still on the sand, in one smooth movement, straightens up and turns it slowly in her fingers, looking at it closely. Calm continuous movement, steady camera, sound of waves.
She stays where she stands and slowly lifts the small seashell to her ear, closes her eyes and listens, the wind in her hair and coat. Calm, gentle movement, steady camera, wind and surf.
